observable_requirements.contract: In the Domain Overview pane, link buttons within the domain forwarding accordion section (.domain-forwarding-card__accordion .link-button, including '+ Add forward', 'Edit', and 'Remove forward') must be styled with the page's standard link color variable var(--color-link).

preserved_behaviors: Other controls and navigation tabs in the Domain Overview pane remain unaffected and functional.
Domain forwarding card form states, validation rules, and mutations continue to operate normally.
behavioral_contract.implementation_variation: The style rule can be nested under .hosting-dashboard-item-view__content or directly attached to .domain-forwarding-card__accordion .link-button, as long as the compiled stylesheet rules cascade color: var(--color-link) to link buttons in the domain forwarding card accordion.

test_bundles.coverage_gap_reason: No existing test executes style compilation or verifies that the domain forwarding link button inherits var(--color-link).
test_bundles.why_assertions_measure_requirements: The test inspects the compiled CSS stylesheet generated from client/my-sites/domains/domain-management/domain-overview-pane/style.scss to verify that the CSS rule targeting .domain-forwarding-card__accordion .link-button explicitly sets color: var(--color-link).
test_bundles.predicted_base_behavior: Base branch does not define color: var(--color-link) for .domain-forwarding-card__accordion .link-button in style.scss, causing the test assertion to fail.
test_bundles.predicted_reference_behavior: Reference branch defines the rule inside style.scss and compiles to CSS containing .domain-forwarding-card__accordion .link-button { color: var(--color-link); }, passing the assertion.
test_bundles.result_parser: Standard Node process exit code: exit code 0 indicates PASS, non-zero code or uncaught AssertionError indicates FAIL.
test_bundles.equivalence_self_check: Alternative valid selectors (e.g. .hosting-dashboard-item-view__content div .domain-forwarding-card__accordion .link-button or direct .domain-forwarding-card__accordion .link-button) setting color: var(--color-link) match the regex and pass.
vacuous_pass_checks: Missing stylesheet file or empty output throws an explicit AssertionError.
Missing target selector or wrong property value (e.g. missing color or setting another color) throws an explicit AssertionError.
test_bundles.surface_signal_resistance: A patch that merely adds comments or applies color to unrelated classes will not produce the required selector-declaration pair and will fail.

negative_variants.defect_preserved_or_introduced: Sets color: #0087be instead of var(--color-link), failing theme variable conformance.
Applies var(--color-link) to .link-button globally outside .domain-forwarding-card__accordion, failing the scoped accordion rule check.

equivalent_positive_variant.description: Declares .domain-forwarding-card__accordion .link-button { color: var(--color-link); } directly at the root level of style.scss without wrapping in .hosting-dashboard-item-view__content div.

annotation.summary: Proposed a deterministic stylesheet verification test bundle that compiles domain-overview-pane/style.scss and verifies that .domain-forwarding-card__accordion .link-button has color: var(--color-link).
